sections.title: P04.1 — execution evidence
sections.text:
Status: GREEN. Independent review concluded GREEN after one targeted fix; approved Golden candidate promoted and four tests / 1208 assertions pass without GOLDEN_UPDATE.

Implemented Api/Spi/SpiKind metadata, an AST source surface scanner, report/strict/write/check CLI, deterministic manifest/documentation generation, package fixtures and exact layout/rename controls. No P04.2 classification/DTO changes or strict CI cutover.

Validation: root SQLite 853 tests / 3643 assertions plus workflow 10 / 54; PostgreSQL 240 / 1149; architecture 92 / 301; all package/product suites pass. Latest Attributes filter 51 / 214 plus workflow. Full PHPStan, lint, layout (159 unchanged records), old graph, ceilings, ownership, docs, rename and anti-weakening pass. All 34 existing mutation controls produce expected failures; ordinary unmutated controls pass, with the documented lane-split empty-selection exception.

Source report: 1180 discovered owners, 20 package manifests, 2710 import diagnostics, 717 unclassified declarations, 272 unresolved-type diagnostics. Report exits 0 and strict exits 1. Fixture tests prove malformed input exits 2, write determinism, stale check, nested payload leaks, inherited signatures, defaults/enums and named parameters.

See proof-index.json for validation-to-log mappings, scanner-contract.md for behavior/integration repairs, observations.md for historical failed runs and subsequent corrections, environment.json for isolated DB targets, and candidate/semantic-delta.json for the reviewed seven-record Golden addition. Existing routes/events/wire, promoted fixtures and rename map retain their preimage bytes.

No hosted CI, push, release or P04.2 execution is claimed.

Product commit: `31f5676d`. One review finding (bare collection PHPDoc bypass) was reproduced by five failing tests and fixed; six collection fixtures, affected Attributes suite and core PHPStan pass. Existing full suites predate only this private scanner correction; no DB/runtime package code changed afterward. `review: cursor/grok-4.7/high GREEN` is preserved in review-verdict.md.

The first review CLI produced no output and was terminated; the successful review is session 23999e2f-5473-4f39-befa-174fafe1a6d6. It was asked to conclude on owner steering, then confirmed only its one fix. No second full audit was performed. The post-commit anti-weakening check required the D64 REBASELINE.md entry in the same product commit; that bookkeeping entry was added and the local commit amended.
